title: Test failing on OSX due to differences in temporary folder paths.

labels.name: core
labels.description: Relates to ESLint's core APIs and features

labels.name: accepted
labels.description: There is consensus among the team that this change meets the criteria for inclusion

labels.name: archived due to age
labels.description: This issue has been archived; please open a new issue for any further discussion

body:
Running `npm test` from head on OSX:

```
1) globUtil listFilesToProcess() should return an array with a resolved (absolute) filename:

      AssertionError: expected [ Array(1) ] to deeply equal [ Array(1) ]
      + expected - actual

       [
      -  "/private/var/folders/_q/001g73y56vl24brvfcv0tl6m0000gn/T/eslint/fixtures/glob-util/one-js-file/baz.js"
      +  "/var/folders/_q/001g73y56vl24brvfcv0tl6m0000gn/T/eslint/fixtures/glob-util/one-js-file/baz.js"
       ]

      at Function.assert.deepEqual (node_modules/chai/lib/chai/interface/assert.js:205:32)
      at Context.<anonymous> (tests/lib/util/glob-util.js:123:20)

  2) globUtil listFilesToProcess() should return all files matching a glob pattern:

      AssertionError: expected [ Array(2) ] to deeply equal [ Array(2) ]
      + expected - actual

       [
      -  "/private/var/folders/_q/001g73y56vl24brvfcv0tl6m0000gn/T/eslint/fixtures/glob-util/two-js-files/bar.js"
      -  "/private/var/folders/_q/001g73y56vl24brvfcv0tl6m0000gn/T/eslint/fixtures/glob-util/two-js-files/foo.js"
      +  "/var/folders/_q/001g73y56vl24brvfcv0tl6m0000gn/T/eslint/fixtures/glob-util/two-js-files/bar.js"
      +  "/var/folders/_q/001g73y56vl24brvfcv0tl6m0000gn/T/eslint/fixtures/glob-util/two-js-files/foo.js"
       ]

      at Function.assert.deepEqual (node_modules/chai/lib/chai/interface/assert.js:205:32)
      at Context.<anonymous> (tests/lib/util/glob-util.js:134:20)

  3) globUtil listFilesToProcess() should return all files matching multiple glob patterns:

      AssertionError: expected [ Array(3) ] to deeply equal [ Array(3) ]
      + expected - actual

       [
      -  "/private/var/folders/_q/001g73y56vl24brvfcv0tl6m0000gn/T/eslint/fixtures/glob-util/two-js-files/bar.js"
      -  "/private/var/folders/_q/001g73y56vl24brvfcv0tl6m0000gn/T/eslint/fixtures/glob-util/two-js-files/foo.js"
      -  "/private/var/folders/_q/001g73y56vl24brvfcv0tl6m0000gn/T/eslint/fixtures/glob-util/one-js-file/baz.js"
      +  "/var/folders/_q/001g73y56vl24brvfcv0tl6m0000gn/T/eslint/fixtures/glob-util/two-js-files/bar.js"
      +  "/var/folders/_q/001g73y56vl24brvfcv0tl6m0000gn/T/eslint/fixtures/glob-util/two-js-files/foo.js"
      +  "/var/folders/_q/001g73y56vl24brvfcv0tl6m0000gn/T/eslint/fixtures/glob-util/one-js-file/baz.js"
       ]

      at Function.assert.deepEqual (node_modules/chai/lib/chai/interface/assert.js:205:32)
      at Context.<anonymous> (tests/lib/util/glob-util.js:149:20)

  4) globUtil listFilesToProcess() should return hidden files if included in glob pattern:

      AssertionError: expected [ Array(1) ] to deeply equal [ Array(1) ]
      + expected - actual

       [
      -  "/private/var/folders/_q/001g73y56vl24brvfcv0tl6m0000gn/T/eslint/fixtures/glob-util/hidden/.foo.js"
      +  "/var/folders/_q/001g73y56vl24brvfcv0tl6m0000gn/T/eslint/fixtures/glob-util/hidden/.foo.js"
       ]

      at Function.assert.deepEqual (node_modules/chai/lib/chai/interface/assert.js:205:32)
      at Context.<anonymous> (tests/lib/util/glob-util.js:166:20)
```
